meta.description: The ORVIBO S30c Smart Plug makes ordinary appliances smart: switch them from your phone or by voice, put them on schedules and countdowns, and stay safe with safety shutters and a casing flame-retardant to 750 °C.
meta.spec.description: ORVIBO S30c Smart Plug specifications: 250 V~, 10 A max, 2.5 kW max, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi b/g/n, −20 to 60 °C.
s30c_sec1.s30c_sec13: Remote control   |   Voice control   |   Smart timers   |   Safety shutters   |   Flame-retardant to 750 °C
s30c_sec2.s30c_sec2: Voice control, for a head start on smart living
s30c_sec2.s30c_sec22:
Works with voice control from Tmall Genie, the voice robot, the ORVIBO Home app and more.
Just say the word, and smart living begins.
s30c_sec2.ss2c_item: A lazy morning, with breakfast ordered by voice
s30c_sec2.ss2c_item2: At night, plug the rice cooker, toaster or soy milk maker into the S30c and get it all ready. In the morning, ask the Xiaobai robot from bed to make breakfast.
s30c_sec2.ss2c_item3: Hey Xiaobai, turn on the dining room plug at 6 a.m.
s30c_sec2.ss2c_item4: Warm in bed? Turn off the lamp with your voice
s30c_sec2.ss2c_item5: On cold winter nights, who wants to leave a warm bed to turn off the light? Plug the lamp into the S30c and the S30c into the wall, and ask Xiaobai to switch it off from bed!
s30c_sec2.ss2c_item6: Hey Xiaobai, turn off the bedside lamp
s30c_sec3.s30c_sec3: Smart power use for every appliance
s30c_sec3.s30c_sec32: Friendly timers and a simple app: set when an appliance gets power in one tap, and the ordinary small devices at home get smarter.
alt.app: The S30c's screen in the ORVIBO Home app: the power button, with Mode, Schedule and Countdown.
s30c_sec4.clear: Water heater on all day, bills soaring?
s30c_sec4.clear2: Time it to your daily routine: less hassle, lower bills.
alt.heater: Workday mode: runs the water heater 1 hour after work. Holiday mode: heats water on off-peak power. Compact 10 A plug: 250 V~, up to 10 A and 2500 W.
s30c_sec4.clear3: Cold out? Come home to a warm house
s30c_sec4.clear4: Put the radiator on a timer: no more waking up cold, no more heater running up the bill. Or switch it on remotely on your way home and walk into a warm house.
s30c_sec4.clear6: Charging a phone for hours, especially overnight, raises safety worries: it heats up, the battery suffers, it might even explode. Set a delay, and the S30c switches off after 3–4 hours.
s30c_sec4.clear7: Fall asleep with the lamp still on?
s30c_sec4.clear8: Sleepy at night, you doze off over a book or your phone, and the lamp burns all night, wasting money and power. Set a repeating schedule that fits your routine: thoughtful and effortless.
s30c_sec5.s30c_sec5: Compact, so more appliances get smart
s30c_sec5.s30c_sec52: Clever sizing and an optimized interior let several S30c plugs sit side by side on one power strip, without blocking the next socket or getting in each other's way.
s30c_sec6.s30c_sec6: Multiple safety protections, higher manufacturing standards
s30c_sec6.s30c_sec62: The casing is V-0 fire-rated material, flame-retardant up to 750 °C, with a one-piece 1.5 mm nickel-plated brass plug. Solid materials that don't deform under heat, for safer, more reliable use.
alt.parts: The front and back covers are V-0 fire-rated PC; the socket has independent safety shutters and nickel-plated brass contacts.
s30c_sec7.s30c_sec7: Switch the power off by hand
s30c_sec7.s30c_sec72: No phone needed: the button switches the power on and off.
s30c_sec8.ss8_content:
Hold the power button/indicator
for 6 seconds until the red light flashes

the blue light stays on
